چه مدل‌هایی از چلنج دارید؟: What challenge models do you offer?
سه مدل خریدنی و یک مسیر رایگان: استاندار: Three purchasable models and one free path: Standard (two-phase), One-phase, Instant (no evaluation, funded from day one) and the 14-day Free Trial. Account sizes run from $5K to $100K, and the Instant challenge up to $200K.
هدف سود هر مدل چقدر است؟: What is each model’s profit target?
استاندارد: ۸٪ در مرحلهٔ اول و ۵٪ در مرحل: Standard: 8% in phase one and 5% in phase two. One-phase: a single 12% target. Instant: no profit target — you are in the payout stage from day one. Targets are measured on closed net profit.
موجودی و ارزش خالص چه تفاوتی دارند؟: What is the difference between balance and equity?
موجودی فقط معاملات بسته‌شده را نشان می‌د: Balance reflects closed trades only; equity also counts the unrealized PnL of open positions in real time. Loss limits are equity-based, so an open loss counts toward the limit immediately.
مهلت و حداقل روز معاملاتی دارید؟: Is there a time limit or minimum trading days?
Purchasable challenges have no time limit. Standard requires at least 3 trading days per phase; One-phase and Instant have none — Instant instead requires 7 profitable days per rolling 30 days. The Free Trial gives you 14 days per phase.
سهم سود و برداشت چگونه است؟: How do reward sharing and payouts work?
استاندارد و تک‌مرحله‌ای: ۸۰٪ در سیکل دوه: Standard and One-phase: 80% on a bi-weekly cycle, or 100% monthly with 7 profitable days and the consistency score. Instant: 95% every 14 calendar days. The first payout is possible 14 days after your first trade, with a minimum request of 1% of account size.
اگر سقف ضرر لمس شود چه اتفاقی می‌افتد؟: What happens if I touch a loss limit?
حساب نقض‌شده تلقی می‌شود و طبق قرارداد ب: The account is considered breached and closes under the agreement; the eligible profit of that period is not withdrawable. The Standard challenge fee is refunded with the fourth reward; other models do not refund the fee.
تست رایگان چه شرایطی دارد؟: What are the Free Trial conditions?
۱۴ روز تقویمی برای هر مرحله، بدون هزینه: 14 calendar days per phase, free, with Standard challenge rules (8% and 5% targets, 5% daily and 10% total loss limits). You can hold only one active trial at a time, and an active paid account blocks starting one. Trial profits cannot be requested and the trial does not convert to a funded account — it exists to rehearse the real path.
مدل مناسب را انتخاب کن و شرایطش را کامل: Pick the model that fits and read its terms in full. Purchase activation is not available in this release; until then, connect a wallet and explore the 100,000 DAI demo account in the terminal, or rehearse the challenge path with the Free Trial.
هزینهٔ ارزیابی یک‌باره است. فعال‌سازی خر: The evaluation fee is one-time. Purchase activation is not available in this release and final terms will be announced before checkout; on passing, the funded account carries up to an 80% reward share — and up to 95% on the Instant challenge.
سقف ضرر روزانه بر مبنای بزرگ‌ترِ موجودی: The daily loss limit is measured against the higher of the day’s opening balance or equity and resets at 00:00 (UTC+3) each day. The total limit is 10% static on Standard and 12% static on One-phase; on the Instant challenge it is 5% trailing and locks at breakeven once the account is 5% in profit. Touching any limit is a breach.
